verified: Fixed inner whole-month halves exactly partition each original allowed outer training set; outer and inner-held labels excluded from corresponding fits.
All raw Rome peers predicted, including supervised-excluded rows; source parameters trained on the same inner complement.
Separate true-offblock noise calibration and original support population resolve the default takeoff-day API trap; unchanged taxi complete-day/count minima required before model fits.
Raw18 plus fixed17 physical scalars and two input identity indicators are source-blind; category maps restricted to base training rows, native missing numeric values.

D0 remains fixed; target-only estimator derivative is one half the joint-minus-departure posterior variance divided by fixed scale times feature vector. Both joint and departure share the same support tilt.

Exact-v80 additive objective delta is distinct from the separately reported prior-family substitution. Frozen primary gate compares posterior objective against both exact v80 and prior-MSE control; no independent confirmation claim.
before_fit_requirements: Implementation/data audit must prove full raw peer counts and exact month/ID exclusions, distinct from 344419 scored rows.
Assert original outer calibration identities and their allowed months; inner support/source parameters must be fresh complement-only artifacts.
Packet inference whitelist must exclude y/true_day; persist immutable supports/messages before reading inner target labels.
Check actual incremental-gradient cancellation/rank/finite differences; previous J-only feasibility does not suffice.
Family diagnostics must use identical nonnegative rounding as primary.
Resource estimates 10-25 minutes,2-4GB,50MB transfer remain estimates until prepared footprint measured; no heavy allocation authorized by this review.

frozen_objective.loss: Mean squared error in units of 3600 seconds plus 0.001*sum(theta**2). Prior arm uses tilted prior mean; posterior arm uses D0+0.5*(Jtheta-Dtheta). Identical supported target set and raw finite y, no clipping or label-based selection.
frozen_objective.scope: One four-vector per outer fold, pooled across its two honest inner prediction banks. No optimizer callback reads outer labels. No hyperparameter/feature/seed/weight scan.
frozen_objective.failure: Persist optimizer failure and stop; do not silently retry with different settings.

limitations: Fixed peer discriminative message is not globally coherent joint differentiation.
The 37-feature prior is a material family substitution; apparent family gains are separate from objective gains.
Outer calibration reuse and raw-feature constructions are still subject to executable provenance checks.
